text: Do you have a history of smoking or exposure to environmental toxins, and have you noticed any persistent cough or shortness of breath? REQUEST TEST: CT Scan Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of bilateral cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy along with splenomegaly, combined with your lymphocytosis, strongly suggests a chronic lymphoproliferative disorder like CLL. To confirm the diagnosis and assess the cell morphology, I need to examine the lymph nodes directly. REQUEST TEST: Lymph Node Biopsy

speaker: Doctor
text: It is highly unusual for a lymph node biopsy to return "normal" readings in the context of significant lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly, so I must re-evaluate the laboratory data. Please clarify if the initial Complete Blood Count showed a specific absolute lymphocyte count, and have you experienced any recurrent infections or bruising? REQUEST TEST: Flow Cytometry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Flow Cytometry: Presence of monoclonal B lymphocytes with a phenotype consistent with CLL/SLL.

speaker: Doctor
text: The flow cytometry results confirming monoclonal B lymphocytes with a CLL/SLL phenotype definitively establish the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL)
